description: This file sets up a FastAPI web application with WebSocket support and a simple HTML interface for a chat example using WebSockets, including handling of cookies, query parameters, and WebSocket messaging.

classes.name: HTMLResponse
classes.description: HTTP response class to return HTML content.

classes.name: WebSocket
classes.description: Represents a WebSocket connection, used for WebSocket communication.

methods.name: get()
methods.description: Handles GET requests to the root path '/', returning an HTML page that serves as a WebSocket chat interface.

methods.name: get_cookie_or_token( websocket: WebSocket, session: Annotated[Union[str, None], Cookie()] = None, token: Annotated[Union[str, None], Query()] = None, )
methods.description: Dependency that retrieves either a session cookie or a query token from WebSocket connection, raising an exception if both are missing.

methods.name: websocket_endpoint( *, websocket: WebSocket, item_id: str, q: Union[int, None] = None, cookie_or_token: Annotated[str, Depends(get_cookie_or_token)], )
methods.description: WebSocket endpoint at '/items/{item_id}/ws' that manages WebSocket communication, echoes received messages, and sends session info.
